meta.title: Pre-decision questions, information and answers register
meta.note: Questions that must be answered, and information that must be gathered, before any decision (site change, strategy deployment, or betting model use) can be reasonably made. Based only on information we have and do not have. Blank answers = information we do not have; flagged, never inferred.
meta.purpose: Separate what is known from what is unknown before any decision.

questions.question: Can an originated NFL spread/total line beat the closing market line?
questions.information_needed: Historical originated lines vs closing lines vs actual outcomes, with MAE and out-of-sample tests.
questions.answer: No — published sessions found the closing line beats the model (root: model spread MAE 10.38 vs market 9.70; skill-lab and quant-lab also found model worse than market; 0 of 7+ strategies passed gates).
questions.source: root Line Lab pages/lines.html; skill-lab/; quant-lab/
questions.decision_relevance: Before originating lines for decisions, confirm the model adds information beyond the close.

questions.question: Are parlay legs independent, and what are the correlation values?
questions.information_needed: Empirical correlation matrix (Pearson r / Gaussian copula) for same-game legs (QB↔WR1, cover↔over, moneyline↔spread) and same-week cross-game legs.
questions.answer: No — legs are correlated. Published values: QB passing yards↔WR1 receiving yards r≈+0.561 to +0.670; cover↔over ≈+0.016; moneyline↔spread φ≈0.649; cross-game φ≈−0.005 (not independent). Independence overclaims were removed.
questions.decision_relevance: Pricing legs independently understates joint probability; combos must use correlation-aware pricing.

questions.question: Is a season win-loss record a predictive signal or mostly luck?
questions.information_needed: Pythagorean expectation, year-over-year luck correlation, persistence tests.
questions.answer: Mostly luck — Pythagorean R²≈0.83 but year-over-year luck correlation ≈0.019 (near zero). Wins above expectation do not persist.
questions.decision_relevance: Do not extrapolate records; treat luck as noise.

questions.question: Can player-prop ROI be measured from public data?
questions.answer: Not here — no historical prop prices exist in the public official feed (NFL–Genius Sports is the exclusive betting-data distributor; prop prices are not public). Blank, not invented.
questions.source: NI-NFL-BDB-ANNOUNCE (exclusive distributor); root Line Lab pages/flagged.html
questions.source_status: official source confirms no public prop prices
questions.decision_relevance: No prop ROI can be published; any prop strategy is unverified.

questions.question: Which players are injured and what is their practice/game status this week?
questions.information_needed: Official NFL injury report (practice status DNP/Limited/Full; game status Questionable/Doubtful/Out).
questions.answer: Published on the /pages/injuries.html page as a Week 10, 2026 snapshot (as-of 2026-11-12) from nfl.com/injuries. Dynamic — re-pull weekly.
questions.decision_relevance: Injury status is a decision input for lineup/availability.

questions.question: Which 2nd/3rd/4th string backups replace injured starters on defense and offense?
questions.information_needed: Official depth-chart ordering (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string) per team per position group.
questions.answer: Not available — the official NFL roster page does NOT publish depth-chart ordering (roster is alphabetical). Depth cells are blank and flagged; no backup inferred.
questions.source_status: official source confirms depth order not published
questions.decision_relevance: Backup-deficiency signal cannot be computed from official data today.

questions.question: Has any strategy passed all validation gates?
questions.information_needed: Strategy backtest results vs a 10-gate set (significance, CLV, sample size, Bonferroni, etc.) with negative/leakage controls.
questions.answer: No — 0 strategies qualified across published sessions (root 0/7, quant-lab 0/21, skill-lab 0/gates). Leaderboard shows no approved strategy.
questions.source: root Line Lab pages/leaderboard.html; quant-lab/; skill-lab/
questions.decision_relevance: No strategy is approved for capital; nothing earns reward.

questions.question: Is there a funded reward pool for the leaderboard?
questions.information_needed: Prize pool, funding source, payout rules, jurisdiction.
questions.answer: No funded prize pool. No sportbook access, price, or limit has been verified. Rewards are a design concept only.
questions.source: root Line Lab pages/flagged.html; disclaimer on every page
questions.decision_relevance: Do not treat leaderboard rewards as real payouts.

questions.question: Is sports wagering legal in the user's jurisdiction?
questions.information_needed: User's location/jurisdiction and local wagering law.
questions.decision_relevance: User must confirm local legality before placing any wager.
questions.status: unanswered — not assessed; answer deliberately blank

questions.question: Are all published site values verified against official sources?
questions.information_needed: Per-row source links; blank/unverified flags where no official source exists.
questions.answer: This site aims for it: every data table row carries an official source link or is blank + flagged. Verification script (scripts/verify_all.py) enforces it.
questions.decision_relevance: Reviewers can trust sourced rows; flagged rows need review.
